## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that addresses it.

## Validation

- [ ] `./scripts/format --check`
- [ ] `./scripts/lint`
- [ ] `./scripts/test`
- [ ] User-facing behavior was verified on the relevant native surface
- [ ] Documentation and tests were updated where needed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` and version metadata were updated when required
- [ ] New behavior exposes a settings/plugin API path or documents the planned extension point
- [ ] `./scripts/version check` and `./scripts/audit-public` pass
- [ ] No credentials, private paths, generated build products, or unrelated changes are included
